dna.family: ONE SCENE, TWO REGISTRY NAMES. `rhizome_cave_demo` and `rhizome_cave_system` both resolve to res://algorithms/spacetopology/marchingcubes/scenes/rhizome_cave_demo.tscn, so both entries declare the same two axes and a sweep of either measures the same object. Path verified rather than assumed: that .tscn's ext_resource names the real RhizomeCaveDemoController.gd and the ROOT node carries it, so both axes are reachable from a map token. DO NOT read algorithms/marchingcubes/scenes/rhizome_cave_demo.tscn — a second file of that name exists there and is an empty three-line stub ([gd_scene format=3] plus a bare Root node), and neither registry entry points at it.
dna.default: anastomosis=netted returns the float 6.0 — the same literal the controller's hardcoded rhizome_params dict has always handed to set_growth_rules — and bore=tunnel returns 1.0, where `radius * 1.0` is the identical bit pattern for every finite float, so carve_sphere receives the argument it always did. Both are SHORT-CIRCUITS out of a constant dictionary, not values re-derived from a formula that happens to land nearby. REACH MEASURED, and it is 3 direct grid placements plus 16 indirect hosts: `rhizome_cave_demo` bare in SpeculativeComputation_Rhizome_Network and bare in ISO_Showcase_12; `rhizome_cave_system:0:-0.5` in Gallery_ProceduralGeneration, which is rotation and y-offset and carries no config; two curation_station rosters (Corridor_SpeculativeComputation_Rhizome_Network and Curation_Bay_postfoundationscrisis_2); and fourteen `exhibit_furniture#kind:floor_work#size:s#mount:rhizome_cave_demo` mounts across eight Trial_* museum maps. The `#` parameters on those host tokens belong to the HOST and are never forwarded to the mounted artifact. Neither registry entry declares default_params, so merged_config is empty at every one of the nineteen and GridInteractablesComponent does not reach _apply_artifact_config at all — the guarded rebuild below is unreachable from every map that exists.
dna.was: merge_distance = 6.0, typed into the rhizome_params dict at RhizomeCaveDemoController:62. The carve radius had no multiplier at all: carve_sphere used node.radius directly, from the initial node radius 3.0 (RhizomeCaveGenerator:332) and the chamber multiplier 2.0 (:366).
dna.note: WHERE THIS ARTIFACT'S FIELD COMES FROM, which is what wave 3 of the isosurfaces sequence is asking. Nowhere else in the sequence is the answer 'from a history'. Every other member samples a function at each lattice point — a gyroid, a noise, a sum of metaball kernels. This one evaluates nothing: generate_cave_async fills the whole chunk with density 1.0 (:346-349) and then SUBTRACTS, carve_sphere writing min(current, dist/voxel_radius) (:265) along a graph that grew iteration by iteration out of an RNG. The field is a record of what happened. Both axes are lifted out of that record, one from the growth and one from the carve, and they are orthogonal by construction: anastomosis decides the graph and never touches a radius; bore scales the radius and cannot reach the graph, because the graph is finished before the first voxel is written. ANASTOMOSIS asks whether a branch that meets an existing one rejoins it or stops. RhizomeGrowthPattern.find_merge_candidate (:171-176) returns the first existing node within merge_distance of a proposed branch tip; on a hit create_connection adds an EDGE and `continue` suppresses the new node, which is the only way a circuit can enter this graph. tree=0.0: nothing is ever within 0 m, so nothing ever merges — a pure arborescence with dead ends and no circuit, the figure Deleuze and Guattari oppose and the thing this artifact's own truth statement claims to refute, rendered here for the first time. netted=6.0 SHIPPED. matted=12.0. knotted=20.0. THE CONFOUND, stated rather than hidden: raising merge_distance both adds edges and SUPPRESSES nodes, because the merging branch does not create the node it was going to create. The network gets loopier and smaller at the same time and no still can separate the two. BORE asks how wide the same graph is carved. The multiplier lives inside carve_sphere, the single gate every carve passes through (carve_tunnel reaches the field only by calling it), so the graph is bit-for-bit identical across all four rungs — same seed, same nodes, same positions, same rng draws. At thread the carve radius is 1.2 m against a 1.0 m voxel and the solid boundary sits at 0.6 of a voxel, so the tube is thinner than the sampling lattice and a continuous field extracts as a broken string of beads; at hollow the tubes swallow each other and the surface merges what the graph deliberately kept apart. Same field-making history, different surface: the boundary is not a property of the field alone.
dna.shares_vocabulary_with: NEW WORDS, both. `anastomosis` is already the project's own — the mycelium substrate work names it as its open gap — and the nearest taken word is `fusion` (the metaballs family), which is how much two FIELDS merge; this is whether two PATHS rejoin, decided in the graph before any field exists. `bore` is not `bulge` (queer_marching_cave), which swells a wall locally as a function of position, and it is deliberately not `resolution`: voxel_scale is held at 1.0 on every rung and only the carve radius moves, which is exactly what makes the lattice interaction legible at thread instead of confounded with it.
dna.crossed_wire: The two axes are orthogonal in the arithmetic and NOT in the picture. A large bore visually fuses tubes the graph never joined, so inside the `hollow` column anastomosis reads weak and inside the `tree` row bore reads weak — both frames are the same swallowed box. GROUP THE CRITIC'S NUMBERS BY VALUE PAIR ACROSS CONTEXTS, not by per-axis mean, or anastomosis will be convicted of the bore's doing. Measured on the replica at the fixture's seed: the weakest single CELL is bore hall x hollow inside the tree row at 0.6%, and the weakest grouped PAIR is anastomosis netted x matted at ~26%. Those two numbers are forty times apart and they are about the same sixteen tiles.
dna.declined: threshold (0.5, RhizomeCaveGenerator:10) — taken by mc_torus_sculpture, and worse: on a field carved as the linear ramp dist/voxel_radius a constant threshold is EXACTLY a uniform change of carve radius, so it would argue with bore for the same pixels. vertical_bias (0.3, applied as direction.y *= vertical_bias at RhizomeGrowthPattern:157) — real and visible, the difference between a flat sheet of tunnels and a ball of them, but it is the same question as `plumb` (mc_cave, mc_inside_cave): which way the field prefers to go. Declined for the rhyme and recorded here rather than dropped. chamber_probability (0.25) — too close to `bulge`, and stochastic: at 0.25 over ~30 iterations the variance between seeds would exceed the difference between rungs. branch_probability (0.6) and max_depth (4) — population counts, the same shape of question as `metaball_count`. voxel_scale and chunk_size — the sampling lattice, i.e. `resolution`, already taken twice. REPORTED, NOT SWEPT: setup_parameters (:285-292) read only chunk_size, voxel_scale and threshold, so the `seed` key every caller has always passed — `"seed": randi()` in this controller, `"seed": 12345, # Reproducible generation` in examples/simple_cave.gd — has never reached the RNG. That key is now read, defaulting to -1, which is the sentinel RhizomeGrowthPattern._init already understood. It is not a bug that shows, which is why it survived.
dna.fixture_why: FOUR NUMBERS AND A FLAG, EACH ANSWERING A MEASURED FAULT. cave_seed=7: RhizomeCaveGenerator:321 built RhizomeGrowthPattern.new(randi()), so five variants of this artifact were five different caves and any bite number would have been noise dressed as evidence (law 4). chunk_extent=24: RhizomeVoxelChunk._init never takes a world_position, so it defaults to Vector3.ZERO and the sampled volume is world 0..N. min/max branch length 3.0..26.0: NOT cosmetic — see `finding`. build_synchronously=true: _ready deferred generate_cave_async and the build then spent five awaited process_frames plus a mesh loop that yields whenever it passes 8 ms, so law 6 was not met as shipped and the capture's 1.1 s settle was a race. The flag is read at the four `await get_tree().process_frame` sites inside the generator and nowhere else, so there is one build path and one thing that can be wrong; every player-facing placement leaves it false, because a 13k-voxel march must not gate map load.
dna.finding: TWO THINGS THE READING FOUND, both invisible to every gate in the loop, both measured on a numpy replica of RhizomeGrowthPattern's growth loop and RhizomeCaveGenerator's carve rather than argued. (1) THE PROPOSED CAPTURE FIXTURE WOULD HAVE PRODUCED A DEAD AXIS THAT LOOKED LIKE A DESIGN FAILURE. find_merge_candidate compares a proposed branch tip against every existing node, and the tip sits at most branch_length from its own parent, which is already a node. So a merge_distance above max_branch_length merges EVERY attempt with its parent, create_connection rejects the self-edge (node1 != node2), and the network never grows past its seed node. At the approved 2.0..6.0 the four rungs replicate as merge rates 0 / 100 / 100 / 100 percent and node counts 175 / 1 / 1 / 1 — netted, matted and knotted would all have photographed as ONE carved sphere, the closest pair would have been 0.00% twice, and the verdict would have been a fact about a fixture. The shipped 5.0..20.0 collapses knotted alone, since 20.0 is exactly max_branch_length. The fixture uses 3.0..26.0, which measures 0 / 34 / 59 / 89 percent merged and 175 / 65 / 18 / 3 nodes: four different graphs, monotone, none degenerate. (2) bore=hollow AT THE APPROVED 3.5 CANNOT BE PHOTOGRAPHED. The multiplier lands on node.radius and create_chambers has already multiplied that by rng 2.0..4.0, so at 3.5 a single chamber reaches 42 m and swallows any chunk this artifact can afford to march. Replicated, the hollow column at 3.5 is 100 / 100 / 93 / 9 percent of the box carved: tree and netted are the same empty box and that anastomosis pair measures 0.0%. hall and hollow are therefore implemented at 1.6 and 2.4, which leaves surface in fifteen of the sixteen cells; thread=0.4 and tunnel=1.0 are exactly as approved, because they are the default and the lattice argument and that is where this axis makes its point.
dna.predicted_degeneracy: PREDICTED BEFORE THE CAPTURE, from the replica run at the fixture's own seed, extent and branch lengths. Grouped BY VALUE PAIR across all four bore columns — which is how `crossed_wire` demands they be read — the weakest anastomosis pair is netted x matted at ~26% of the projected silhouette: the two middle rungs differ 3.6x in node count (65 against 18) but both silhouettes are dominated by the same root chamber and its first-generation tunnels. tree x netted is ~34% and matted x knotted ~33%. The weakest bore pair is hall x hollow at ~16%. The silhouette is a projection and therefore an UPPER bound on a rendered frame, so expect roughly a third of these on frame: netted x matted around 8%, hall x hollow around 5%. THE APPROVED DESIGN PREDICTED matted x knotted as the closest anastomosis pair at ~7%, and the replica disagrees — it is the strongest of the three, because knotted collapses to three nodes while matted still carries eighteen. A prediction that agrees with the sweep is worth nothing; this one already disagrees with the design it came from, and the disagreement is what found the fixture fault above.
dna.budget: chunk_extent 24 is 13,824 voxels against the shipped 1,728 — 8x — and the mesh march is one 8-corner lookup per voxel per tile. The carve is the real cost and it is bore-dependent: replicated over all sixteen tiles at the fixture's seed it totals 13.0M voxel writes, about 0.8M per tile. That is only affordable because carve_tunnel's sample spacing is now floored at a quarter of the carved radius on the rungs above 1.0; at the shipped half-voxel spacing bore=hollow alone sweeps the entire chunk about fifty times per tunnel. Four samples per radius cannot leave a seam between consecutive spheres, and the gate is `carve_radius_scale > 1.0`, so bore=tunnel and bore=thread evaluate the shipped expression unchanged. Do not reach for 40^3: that is 37x and will meet the 16-second rule.
dna.rebuild_guard: apply_grid_config was a bare `pass` — a method that existed only so the grid's has_method() check would find it. It now stamps config_<key> metadata, re-reads the overrides and compares a signature built from the same accessors the build calls (_merge_distance(), _bore_scale(), cave_seed, chunk_extent, both branch lengths, build_synchronously), so the signature cannot drift out of step with what reaches the generator. Equal signature returns before touching anything. A real change calls _rebuild(), which frees ONLY RhizomeCaveGenerator._owned — the CaveMesh and CaveCollision this script created — and re-runs the same build; a blanket free of get_children() is what cost three scripts a pass in an earlier wave. _ready reads the metadata BEFORE building, and on the grid's own ordering (config stamped at GridInteractablesComponent:1195, add_child at :1220, apply_grid_config deferred afterwards) the first build already has the right values and the deferred call finds nothing to do: exactly one build per spawn.
dna.still_note: Nothing in this scene runs _process. More usefully, the picture is unusually literal about the axis: the chunk starts solid and RhizomeVoxelChunk.get_density (:38) returns 1.0 out of bounds, so the outer faces of the box carry no surface of their own and the only geometry is the inner wall of the carved network, drawn cull_mode CULL_DISABLED (:384). The frame IS the graph as a set of tubes, and a tree and a knotted net are different objects on sight. The one thing a still cannot separate is the confound named in `note`: loopier and smaller arrive together.
dna.kin: isosurfaces wave 3, the field-provenance wave. metaballs owns `fusion` and `metaball_count`, gyroid_demo `intrusion` and `period`, mc_torus_sculpture `threshold`, queer_marching_cave `bulge`, mc_cave and mc_inside_cave `plumb` — all of them properties of a function being sampled. This is the only member whose field is carved rather than evaluated, which is why its two words are about a history (whether paths rejoined) and a tool (how wide the cut was).

dna.default: posture=line, emphasis=none - line runs the original centring loop verbatim and emphasis=none leaves highlighted_term empty, so all 13 existing placements render exactly as before

dna.note: declared by hand 2026-07-29 - the sweep refused it as NO TURNABLE KNOBS because the five existing exports (animate, pulse_speed, glow_intensity, font_size, depth) had no apply_grid_config to reach them, and none of them changes what the formula argues. entry.qfep_connection: synthesis: the whole formula in the air — QFE = F − λE(S) + φΔE(S,t), each term glowing its signature color, answering the sliders live. The project's thesis as a walkable object: free energy, entropy drive, and the felt rate of change, summed.
